TailorGraph uses heic-to 1.5.2 by Hopper Gee, unmodified, for optional
in-browser HEIC/HEIF conversion. It is loaded as a separate asynchronous
module and is licensed under LGPL-3.0-or-later, without warranty.

Source, including the bundled libheif decoder and build scripts:
https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to
Exact published distribution (includes src/ and esbuild.mjs):
https://registry.npmjs.org/heic-to/-/heic-to-1.5.2.tgz
License: /third-party/heic-to-LICENSE.txt
GPL v3 incorporated by LGPL v3: /third-party/GPL-3.0.txt
Upstream license: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt

The library includes libheif (LGPL-3.0):
https://github.com/strukturag/libheif

TailorGraph integration source and package lock:
https://github.com/rbojboi/tailorgraph
The conversion module can be replaced by changing the heic-to dependency
and rebuilding with npm run build; it is not modified by this integration.
